question:
Rectify the sentence by selecting the correct spelling from the options.

While threatening the integrity of Universal values, the campaign to spread democracy will not succeed.
solution:
```html

The correct answer is: **Option 2 (Succeed)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Succeed"** means to achieve the desired aim or result. (सफल होना)

 
 
• **Example:** Hard work and dedication are essential to succeed in life.
